candidate_chain_cardinality.definition: L_chain(P)=number of primitive edges in the ordered footprint chain
candidate_chain_cardinality.axis_anchor: L_chain=r on every straight r-edge axis anchor
candidate_chain_cardinality.typing: valid native path-length observable for the chain carrier

candidate_endpoint_displacement.definition: L_disp(P)=native primal-graph distance from O_E to the free endpoint p
candidate_endpoint_displacement.axis_anchor: L_disp=r on every radius-r axis anchor
candidate_endpoint_displacement.triangle_flip_effect: 1<->2 flips preserve endpoints and therefore preserve L_disp; terminal pivots can change L_disp
candidate_endpoint_displacement.typing: valid native endpoint-displacement observable, but not proved identical to physical segment length

exact_disagreement_witness.direct_triangle_reduction: O -> (0,1) has L_chain=1 and the same free endpoint
exact_disagreement_witness.consequence: the two source-free candidates agree on all axis anchors but disagree on a legal triangle footprint

conclusion: A carrier-specific path length can be defined, but a carrier-independent pre-circle general-radius segment-length invariant is not uniquely determined.
